summary: Verified both deliverables: React root app and standalone /logiciel-ticket-asteo.html. Labels 'P1:' and 'P2:' correctly displayed (no old 'F :'). PDF generation works on both; downloads captured via Playwright accept_downloads. Both PDFs have valid %PDF header and A4 MediaBox (595.28 x 841.89 pt). Filename input changes are honored on both. Standalone shows '✓ PDF enregistré : <name>.pdf' status message. jsPDF (window.jspdf.jsPDF) and html2canvas both load from CDN.
critical_code_review_comments: TicketDoc is rendered twice (visible + off-screen for print) with the same data-testid='ticket-document'. Not a bug but causes strict-mode locator collisions in tests. Consider a distinct testid for the print copy or aria-hidden markers.

React handleSave falls back to opening a new tab when running inside an iframe (preview). This is correct for the preview environment; production/top-level execution triggers real download as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React app: /tmp/dl/9848.pdf and TESTFILE_react_123.pdf both MediaBox 595.28x841.89 pt (A4). Standalone: 9848.pdf (5.7MB) and TESTFILE_standalone_456.pdf, both A4. Ticket image placed 80mm wide top-right at x=210-80-8mm, y=8mm (real size, no scaling). Labels confirmed: 'P1:' and 'P2:' (old 'F :' removed). No console errors seen.
